attribute_fields.COMMENTS: North Dakota state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure per ND tax code (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "North Dakota Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate North Dakota tax - Single filer (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.nd_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max /nd_taxable_income xdef
0 /nd_tax xdef
nd_taxable_income result.nd_single_bracket_1_limit min result.nd_bracket_1_rate mul nd_tax add /nd_tax xdef
nd_taxable_income result.nd_single_bracket_1_limit gt { nd_taxable_income result.nd_single_bracket_2_limit min result.nd_single_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.nd_bracket_2_rate mul nd_tax add /nd_tax xdef } if
nd_taxable_income result.nd_single_bracket_2_limit gt { nd_taxable_income result.nd_single_bracket_2_limit sub result.nd_bracket_3_rate mul nd_tax add /nd_tax xdef } if
nd_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"North Dakota tax (Single) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate North Dakota tax - Married filing jointly (progressive brackets)
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.nd_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max /nd_taxable_income xdef
0 /nd_tax xdef
nd_taxable_income result.nd_joint_bracket_1_limit min result.nd_bracket_1_rate mul nd_tax add /nd_tax xdef
nd_taxable_income result.nd_joint_bracket_1_limit gt { nd_taxable_income result.nd_joint_bracket_2_limit min result.nd_joint_bracket_1_limit sub 0 max result.nd_bracket_2_rate mul nd_tax add /nd_tax xdef } if
nd_taxable_income result.nd_joint_bracket_2_limit gt { nd_taxable_income result.nd_joint_bracket_2_limit sub result.nd_bracket_3_rate mul nd_tax add /nd_tax xdef } if
nd_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"North Dakota tax (Joint) calculated: $" result.state_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: North Dakota military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_description: Initialize ND military retirement exclusion calculation
initial_action.action_postfix: "ND Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from ND taxable income
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.nd_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.nd_subtractions get result.nd_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.nd_subtractions xdef
"ND Military Retirement Exclusion (Full): $" result.nd_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.nd_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "ND Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
